---
name: backlog-breakdown
description: Use when an issue needs a design, acceptance criteria, or ordered implementation tasks before coding.
---

# Backlog Breakdown

Record why the work matters, concrete numbered acceptance criteria, important
design decisions and rejected alternatives, and an ordered task list. Each
task should be independently reviewable and name its validation command or
observable result. Link child issues or a checklist from the parent issue.

Keep the breakdown current as implementation changes the plan. Do not start
coding when the issue still requires an unresolved design decision.
